findings.problem: The javadoc of criticFixture still says 'CR-PASS / CR-ICS / CR-CERT'. Since FR-58, CR-JUMP is the standard 'critic fails once' fixture and CR-ICS is only the rejected legacy answer. A reader who goes by the comment may script CR-ICS where they want a regeneration, and then gets a retry-then-PASS instead.
findings.fix: Change the comment to 'CR-PASS / CR-JUMP / CR-CERT, plus CR-ICS (legacy answer, now a parse error)'.

findings.problem: Style only. The parser lists IGNORED_COUNTER_SIGNALS as excluded in two places: the TYPES filter at line 32 and the lookup loop at line 95. Line 32 is also much longer than the rest of the file. Today the result is correct: the six types appear in spec order because the openapi enum order is kept. But a later enum change would have to update both places.
findings.fix: Add one private static final List<CriticIssueType> ACCEPTED (the generated values without IGNORED_COUNTER_SIGNALS). Build TYPES from it and look types up in it.
